title: Uniform interior gradient Hölder estimates for infinity-harmonic functions
exact_target: For every $d\geq 3$, are there $\alpha _d\in (0,1/3]$ and $C_d<infinity$ such that every bounded continuous viscosity solution of the infinity-Laplace equation on the unit ball belongs to $C^{1,\alpha _d}$ on the half ball and has ||grad $u||_infinity+[grad$ $u]_{C^\alpha _d}\leq C_d$ $osc_{B1}u$?
